title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
description: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

title: Are Republican voters still loyal to Trump? What new polls say.
description: Plus: How polls actually work with caller ID.

title: Trump displays an all-male lineup of top aides on Asia trip
description: The delegation traveling with the president had an absence of women in senior roles not seen in decades.

title: At historic summit, Xi and Putin share global stage with weakened Trump
description: The president’s first trilateral meeting with the leaders of China and Russia highlighted a shifting global order but resulted in little consensus.

title: Anthropic gave $40M to an AI safety group. Most of the candidates it backed won.
description: As discussions of AI regulations accelerate, the company spent the past year pouring money into groups that spent big on the U.S. midterm elections.

title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
description: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

title: Trump calls Putin and Xi friends. They have other plans.
description: The president sees his willingness to engage authoritarian leaders as a virtue, but critics say the approach could allow them to exploit his appetite for adoration.

title: Hobbled at home, Trump turns abroad
description: In nearly every presidency — often after a stinging midterm defeat — presidents turn their attention overseas.

title: Hakeem Jeffries and his team will seek to deliver a new era for House Democrats
description: Jeffries and his top deputies are poised to lead next year’s majority. They must navigate rival factions, and some question whether they are up to the task.

title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
description: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
description: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

title: Ben Shapiro on conservative media and the future of the Republican Party
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep sits down with conservative commentator Ben Shapiro to discuss the future of the Republican party.

title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
description: President Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin have gathered in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.

title: Elon Musk says he regrets midterm spending
description: The world's wealthiest person said he feels "pretty foolish" after "Republicans were routed."

title: Judge blocks construction of Trump’s arch for two more weeks
description: U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan said she is still weighing arguments on the towering arch, which would be built near Arlington National Cemetery.

title: Two weeks later, Senate vote count is complete, the House nearly finished
description: There are still seven uncalled House races, where the uncounted votes mean either candidate could win.

title: These are the Senate Democrats backing Schumer and Van Hollen for majority leader
description: The Post is tracking senators’ public comments on the fight for Senate majority leader in the next Congress.

title: See where votes are being counted in Senate and House midterm races
description: These maps show how quickly different parts of the country tabulated elections results in the 2026 Senate and House races.

title: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries nominated to be first Black speaker of House next year
description: The full House, including Republicans, is scheduled to vote Jan. 3 for the chamber’s next leader.

title: Leading House Democrat targets Trump’s inner circle for first investigations
description: Incoming Oversight Committee Chairman Robert Garcia wants to investigate the president’s sons, the vice president and others.

title: How Democrats in Congress can investigate Trump
description: The executive branch has significant ability to fight back.

title: Democrats reach largest national House vote margin since Watergate
description: Republicans are losing the national House vote by 14 percentage points in the latest tallies.

title: At least seven progressives voted against Hakeem Jeffries for speaker
description: Many progressives in the base have questioned whether the New Yorker should be speaker.

title: The law releasing the Epstein files passed one year ago. What do his victims say?
description: It's been a year since the House passed the Epstein Files Transparency Act, forcing the Justice Department to release millions of files connected to the convicted sex offender. His victims speak out.

title: Senate panel vote on National Science Foundation nominee is abruptly pulled
description: Move comes amid concerns by Chairman Bill Cassidy (R) that former HHS official Jim O’Neill “did not do enough to stand up for science.”

title: Why the Nvidia scandal is a national security issue
description: The Nvidia scandal has spilled over into the Trump administration, which is now under intense scrutiny for how it allowed America's top AI chips to end up in China's hands.

title: Democrats nominate Jeffries for speaker, prep investigations into Trump's orbit
description: Democrats gave the official nod to Hakeem Jeffries to be the next speaker of the House. Meanwhile, Democrats are ramping up their plans to investigate the Trump administration come January.

title: Democratic strategists think Montana House race could hold the secret to future wins
description: Montana is sending a Democrat to the U.S. House for the first time in three decades. Many in the party think Sam Forstag's campaign may be a playbook for how Democrats can win again in rural America.

title: Democratic Black women take over almost all state agencies in Georgia soon
description: In January, most of Georgia's state agencies will be headed by Black women who were all elected in the 2026 midterms.

title: Peltola win doesn’t end DOJ scrutiny of Alaska Senate race, officials say
description: A criminal case is probing whether a spoiler candidate was recruited in an effort to confuse voters.

title: Hegseth survives impeachment fight, but more political threats await
description: As Democrats promise to force the defense chief from office, his continued favor with the president appears to outweigh any liability he has created — for now.

title: Trump to project friendship with Xi as trade and tech rivalry deepens
description: Tensions between the two largest economic powers have heightened in the weeks leading up to the economic summit in China that starts Wednesday.

title: Trump was once celebrated by people distancing themselves from his politics
description: After the president and his political movement took a significant beating in the 2026 midterms, some supporters are changing their tune.

title: Senate majority leader fight intensifies as Schumer, Van Hollen dig in
description: Both Democrats are back in Washington and seeking to make their case to colleagues before a scheduled vote Dec. 1 by secret ballot.

title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska seat, giving Democrats a 56-44 edge in Senate
description: The race was the last to be called in the Senate, securing Democrats a historic sweep of nine new seats.

title: White House pulls FDA nominee amid political pushback
description: Heidi Overton has been questioned by some in the GOP, many Democrats and prominent Make America Healthy Again supporters.

title: Jeffries seeks to shore up support ahead of vote for Democratic speaker nominee
description: The New York Democrat is on track in January to become the first Black American to hold the post.

title: This Texas prosecutor says he’ll investigate Democrats investigating Trump
description: Aaron Reitz, the U.S. attorney in South Texas, has raised eyebrows with his recent letters to lawmakers in Washington. Are they signs of serious probes or just posturing?

title: Judge orders release of some search warrant documents in Rep. Ilhan Omar case
description: The Minnesota Democrat’s D.C. home was searched in October.

title: DHS chief defends flying to Louisiana for football in ground stop’s aftermath
description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin took a government plane to a college football game as thousands of travelers remained stranded Saturday.

title: New lawmakers play a Capitol Hill game, with prime office space as the prize
description: For incoming freshmen, the ritual of the House office lottery makes their wins feel real.

title: GOP congressman who lost Colorado swing district will run for Boebert’s seat
description: Rep. Gabe Evans’s move would be the second by a Colorado Republican to seek refuge in the redder 4th District, where Rep. Lauren Boebert recently lost.

title: GOP Rep. James Comer launches campaign for Kentucky governor
description: Comer announced his campaign weeks before Democrats are set to retake the majority in the House.
